Name: Xiddav's Parks - Community Center and Sewer
Author: xiddav
Description:
community center and sewers edit and expansion.


Adds three sewer tunnels.
Sewer Forest (south of main sewers that leads to forest)
Sewer CC (North of main sewer with a ladder to the Community Center and another sewer room)
Sewer Spa (North of Sewer CC. Has two ladders that take you to the showers.)

All three has garbage and slime ball forage, plus clay nodes to mine.
CC and Spa has a slight spider problem.
The special sewer room has a monster of it's own and a rare node to mine.

Bug Land has been edited to add more land area.
Slimejacks are more valuable (100 -> 300) and have a new item they make in a fish pond.

Community Center kitchen can be used to cook.


Note:
This mod probably doesn't work with any other mod that changes the Community Center or Sewers.
